title: Example detected
description: REFERENCE event type — the copyable shape of an IFA event payload. To author a real one, copy this file and rename it to '<your_event>@1.json': the filename stem (before '@') is the immutable event_type slug and the number after '@' is the payload version. The backend seeds every contracts/event_types/*.json into the event_types registry and validates every ingested payload against it (additionalProperties:false — unknown fields are rejected). See docs/AUTHORING_A_MODULE.md.

count.description: Required scalar example — how many things were detected this event.

confidence.description: Required 0..1 example — detector confidence for this event.

label.description: Optional free-text example — a human-readable label.

category.description: Optional enum example — how to constrain a field to a fixed set of values.

detections.description: Optional bounded-array-of-objects example (mirrors a detection-box list). Always cap arrays with maxItems.

bbox.description: [x1, y1, x2, y2] pixel coords in the source frame.
